'''Centurion''' was a [[police rank]] in the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Imperial Sector Police]], created after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A centurion was below a [[Prefect (Coruscant police)/Legends|Prefect]] and oversaw a unit of [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. At a demonstration at the [[Imperial City University]], a [[Unidentified centurion|centurion]] ordered its violent dispersal. The centurion was later arrested pending a trial.
